skill_name: Describe the application of blockchain technology in the field of finance.
workflow: Blockchain technology has become increasingly popular in the finance industry for its ability to provide secure, transparent, and immutable transactions. By using distributed ledger technology, blockchain networks provide encrypted, time-stamped records of transactions, which allows for greater accountability and traceability of data without the need for third-party intermediaries.
